narrative: Material PL1__M7E573E7 exhibits variable demand with mean daily consumption of 888 units and coefficient of variation 22.34%. Lead time is erratic with average 2.2 days (CV: 57.43%). The recommended safety stock of 1928 units provides 95% service level protection against demand and lead time variability. The optimal order quantity of 2671 units balances ordering costs ($4187/year) against holding costs ($5785/year), with a review period of 3 days. Lead Time Variability is the dominant factor affecting inventory requirements (94% of variability). The recommended safety lead time of 2.2 days compares to the current SAP setting of 3.0 days.
warnings: Optimized policy has higher cost than SAP policy due to required safety stock

research_insights.selection_rationale: Standard EOQ approach with 95% service level for variable demand
